I made the script prioritize mining the most important ores, while also mining the less important ones (to prevent a non-important ore from appearing after I destroy an important one).

However, with Ore Target enabled, a problem occurs: high-rarity ores do not exist in low-quality rocks, so the script stops destroying those low-quality rocks because the rare ore never appears.

This leads to a future issue: if the script keeps gradually destroying only the rocks that contain rare ores, eventually only low-quality ore rocks will remain, since the script considers that it never detected the selected target ore in them.

Is there a way to fix this? Maybe by adding an option to choose which type of rock the Ore Target should be applied to?
